samples.content:

import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    a = list(map(int, data[1:1 + n]))
    a.sort()
    low = a[0]
    high = a[-1]
    print((low + high) // 2)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
